title: StrikeAdmins
description: StrikeAdmins is a Minecraft plugin that replaces standard bans and kicks with cinematic punishment sequences — levitation, lightning strikes, and particle effects. Fully configurable with multi-language support and simple time-based ban syntax.
body:
StrikeAdmins ⚡
Punish rule-breakers in style! A plugin by Wuesty.
Tired of boring vanilla bans? StrikeAdmins turns every punishment into an epic, server-wide event that no one will forget.

✨ Key Features
When a player gets banned, they don't just silently disappear — they levitate into the air, get struck by a real lightning bolt, and are surrounded by End Rod particles and clouds that signal justice to everyone on the server. Every punishment becomes a moment.
The plugin supports both ru.yml and en.yml language files, and ban screen messages are fully customizable directly in the config — with color code support (&) and line breaks.

🛠 Commands
Use /sban <player> <time> [reason] to ban a player with full effects, /skick <player> [reason] to kick them, /sunban <player> to unban, and /sreload to reload the config and language files.

📝 Time Format
Time is specified as 30m (30 minutes), 12h (12 hours), 1d (1 day), or perm / 0 for a permanent ban.
